title: Planner: add times to task start, finish and due dates
summary: Hold: the Teams app control incorrectly reports that its automation is not documented, although Microsoft documents a cmdlet and its app-state parameter. The warning about contradictory example values is justified, but does not establish that the operation is absent. The roadmap facts, beta calendar operation and narrowly stated feature-specific documentation gaps are otherwise supported.

claims.claim: Automation for changing the Planner app's Teams availability or app state is not yet documented.
claims.quote: This cmdlet updates app state and app available values for the Microsoft Teams app. ... Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <String> [-IsBlocked <Boolean>] ... -IsBlocked: The state of the app in the tenant.
claims.fix: Set controls[0].api to kind powershell, call 'Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app-id> -IsBlocked <boolean>', docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/update-m365teamsapp'. Replace the note's final sentence with 'The reference documents -IsBlocked as Boolean, but describes examples using both $true and $false as unblocking; confirm the intended value before using this cmdlet, or use the documented Block control.' Do not infer a blocking Boolean value from the parameter name.
